boundary: Read-only release-source inspection for recorded installed versions. Archives are hash-verified against the retained reference lock. No installation, imports, execution, shell, or arbitrary URLs. Universal wheels contain Python source; sdists are corresponding release source, not evidence of the exact installed binary or its build options. Direct-reference, editable, ambiguous or unparsed records do not authorize a registry fallback or arbitrary URL retrieval. Unavailable source remains an explicit evidence gap.
